title: SOOTS & the Love House
description: Since 2010, SOOTS has learned alongside UNC-Chapel Hill's Center for the Study of the American South at the Love House.
subtitle: Since 2010

blocks.body: Since 2010, SOOTS has learned alongside UNC-Chapel Hill's Center for the Study of the American South, which makes its home in the Love House. Following the example of Bill Ferris and his colleagues, our students have been introduced to oral histories, folklife archives and folklore professors. We have organized panels and performances at the Love House, toured the Southern Folklife Collection, responded to Bill Ferris' photography from “The South in Color” in our 2017 projects, and built our Food Folklore projects on the work of Bill and Marcie Cohen Ferris.
